notes.title: Coming soon: Torla, from the makers of Qora - live on Kickstarter now
notes.content:
If you enjoyed Qora, but felt there was more fun to be had, we invite you to check out “Torla” our newest project, currently on Kickstarter:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/holdenboyles/874494729?token=c02bf365

In Torla, you are washed up on the shores of a strange and magical land, unsure of why or how you arrived there. After learning to survive in this new world, you begin to unravel its mysteries and with the help of its bizarre denizens, discover your own history and find your way back home!

Just like Qora before it, Torla will take you through whimsical landscapes, have you conversing with quirky characters, and will again have a serene and moving soundtrack to sooth you on your journey. 

Only this time, you must survive in and inhabit the world around you; farming, fishing, and hunting for food. Building camps and structures for shelter and navigation. Crafting tools to harvest resources from the environment and aid in quests. All of this and more await when exploring the open world of Torla!

notes.title: New Film Kickstarter
notes.content:
Hey Qora Fans, 
 
If you've played through Qora and are still craving some more of the magic, take a moment to check out my new Kickstarter campaign: kck.st/1IkDBD9 
After finishing Qora, I returned to my roots as a filmmaker and have been traveling the western United States in a 20 ft moving truck / mobile home, shooting and producing three whimsical films in landscapes similar to those of Qora. 

One of those films, "Lucidia", follows a very mysterious character (who appears in Qora!) on a strange journey of dreams, rituals and alternate realities. 

With the help of our rambling film crew, we were able to piece together a short documentary that showcases how I and my film partner live and create from the back of a tiny box truck home: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g0AWtO4gCPQ
So if you'd like to see one of the Qora narratives come to life on the big screen, please consider supporting our Kickstarter campaign!
 
Thanks everyone, and make sure to grab Qora during the summer sale!
 
Holden Boyles
